extracted.intended_audience: users and developers of the Asymptote vector graphics language; people looking for project info, licensing, and contribution/reporting channels
extracted.subtask_description: Project README for the Asymptote vector-graphics language describing project purpose, licensing, where to get/install the software, where to report bugs or ask questions, and links to third-party dependencies and licenses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project purpose / scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Asymptote is a powerful descriptive vector graphics language for technical drawing, inspired by MetaPost but with an improved C++-like syntax. Asymptote provides for figures the same high-quality level of typesetting that LaTeX does for scientific text.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to obtain installation, documentation, binaries, and source
rubrics_metrics.description: Installation instructions, documentation, binaries, and source code are available at: https://asymptote.sourceforge.io
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The README points users to the project website for downloads and documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bug/patch/feature-request reporting channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Bugs/Patches/Feature Requests can be submitted to https://github.com/vectorgraphics/asymptote/issues
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the project's GitHub issues page to report problems or propose changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Questions and discussion channel
rubrics_metrics.description: Questions and comments should be sent to the Asymptote Forum: https://sourceforge.net/p/asymptote/discussion/409349
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User support and community discussion are handled via the SourceForge forum referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Source code license (LGPL v3 or later)
rubrics_metrics.description: All source files in the Asymptote project, unless explicitly noted otherwise, are released under version 3 (or later) of the GNU Lesser General Public License (see the files LICENSE.LESSER and LICENSE in the top-level source directory).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The README explicitly states LGPL v3+ as the license for source files and directs readers to the included LICENSE files for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Redistribution/modification terms and warranty disclaimer
rubrics_metrics.description: This program is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU Lesser General Public License as published by the Free Software Foundation; either version 3 of the License, or (at your option) any later version. This program is distributed in the hope that it will be useful, but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard GPL/LGPL redistribution and warranty-disclaimer language is included; follow the license files for full legal terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Windows binary licensing constraint (GPL due to bundled GPL libraries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Note that the MSWindows executable of Asymptote available on https://asymptote.sourceforge.io and https://ctan.org can only be released under the GNU General Public License (GPL) as it ships with the GNU Scientific Library, GNU Readline library, and other GPL libraries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Because the distributed Windows executable bundles GPL-licensed libraries, the binary distribution must be GPL — this is a constraint distinct from the LGPL license stated for most source files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party library sources and dependency links
rubrics_metrics.description: Source code for the various dll libraries that ship with this version of Asymptote is available as follows: fftw3: https://www.fftw.org/fftw-3.3.10.tar.gz; getopt: https://github.com/libimobiledevice-win32/getopt; freeglut: https://github.com/freeglut/freeglut; gsl/gslcblas: https://ftp.gnu.org/gnu/gsl/gsl-2.8.tar.gz; libcurl: https://github.com/curl/curl; pthreadVC3: https://sourceforge.net/projects/pthreads4w/files/pthreads4w-code-v3.0.0.zip; readline: https://github.com/xiaozhuai/readline-win32; zlib1: https://github.com/madler/zlib/releases/tag/v1.3.1
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The README lists the bundled third-party libraries and provides direct links to their source distributions; useful for auditing licenses or rebuilding binaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Asset/icon licensing
rubrics_metrics.description: Source for various icons is available under the MIT license from https://github.com/driftyco/ionicons/archive/v2.0.1.zip and https://github.com/iconic/open-iconic/archive/master.zip, under the CC-BY-SA 4.0 license: http://www.entypo.com/, and under a CC license: http://www.zondicons.com/zondicons.zip
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The README documents differing licenses for bundled icons and assets (MIT, CC-BY-SA 4.0, and other CC), which affects how those assets may be reused or redistributed.
